name: Ration Card (NFSA / BPL / APL)
documents: Aadhaar Cards of all family members
Address Proof (Electricity Bill / Water Bill / Rent Agreement)
Income Certificate from Tehsildar / Village Officer
Passport-size Photograph of Woman Head of Family
Bank Passbook (first page with IFSC & Account Number)
Surrender Certificate or Deletion Certificate (if moving from another card)

name: Senior Citizen Card (National / State)
documents: Proof of Age 60+ (Aadhaar Card / Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate)
Proof of Residence (Voter ID / Utility Bill / Domicile Certificate)
Passport-size Photographs (3 copies)
Blood Group Report / Medical History Card
Emergency Contact & Next of Kin Details

name: Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS / National Social Assistance)
documents: Aadhaar Card (linked to active mobile number)
Age Proof verifying 60+ years (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Birth Certificate)
BPL Ration Card or BPL Survey Inclusion Certificate
Bank / Post Office Account Passbook (Aadhaar seeded for DBT)
Domicile / Residence Certificate
Passport-size Photographs (2 copies)

name: Ayushman Bharat Health Card (PM-JAY Golden Card)
documents: Aadhaar Card (mandatory for biometric e-KYC)
Ration Card or PM-JAY Eligibility Letter (Family ID)
Active Mobile Number (for OTP verification)
Income / Caste Certificate (if applying under state health welfare quota)
fee: Free at Government Centres / Empanelled Hospitals

name: PAN Card (New / Correction)
documents: Aadhaar Card (fastest paperless e-KYC)
Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / Matriculation Marksheet / Passport)
Address Proof (Voter ID / Utility Bill / Bank Statement)
Passport-size Photographs (2 copies with white background)

name: Aadhaar Update (Address, Mobile & Biometrics)
documents: Original Aadhaar Card Number
Valid Address Proof (Utility Bill / Passport / Bank Statement / Rent Agreement)
Proof of Identity (for Name correction: Passport / PAN / Gazette Notification)
Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / School Transfer Certificate)
Active Mobile Number for OTP Verification

name: Disability Certificate & UDID Card (Unique Disability ID)
documents: Medical Assessment Report from District Hospital / Medical Board
Aadhaar Card or Photo Identity Proof
Address Proof (Domicile Certificate / Utility Bill / Voter ID)
Recent Colored Passport-size Photograph (white background)
Scanned Signature or Thumb Impression
Existing State Disability Certificate (if applying for renewal/digital UDID)

name: Voter ID Card (EPIC New Enrollment / Shift Address)
documents: Aadhaar Card
Proof of Age (Birth Certificate / Aadhaar / Matriculation Certificate)
Address Proof (Electricity Bill / Water Bill / Passport / Bank Passbook)
Passport-size Photograph
Filled Form 6 (New voter) or Form 8 (Correction / Address shift)

name: Income Certificate (Tehsildar / Revenue Department)
documents: Aadhaar Card
Salary Slip / Form 16 / Income Tax Return / Self-declaration Affidavit
Ration Card or Family Register Copy
Address Proof (Utility Bill / Voter ID)
Agricultural Land Holding Documents (for rural / farmer families)
Passport-size Photograph

name: Caste / Community Certificate (SC / ST / OBC / EWS)
documents: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
Father's / Blood Relative's Caste Certificate or School Leaving Certificate
Ration Card / Family Register showing applicant name
Land Record / Revenue Document mentioning ancestral community
Self-declaration Affidavit
Passport-size Photographs

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate
documents: Aadhaar Card
Proof of Continuous Residence for 3–5 years (Utility Bills / Rent Agreements)
School / College Leaving Certificate showing years of study in the state
Parents' Domicile Certificate or Land Ownership Proof
Voter ID / Ration Card
Passport-size Photograph

name: Legal Heir Certificate (Varisu Certificate)
documents: Original Death Certificate of the Deceased
Aadhaar Cards of all surviving legal heirs (Spouse, Children, Parents)
Family Ration Card / Smart Card listing all family members
Sworn Affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper declaring all legal heirs
Marriage Certificate (for surviving spouse) or Birth Certificates (for children)
Service Book / Pension Order (if deceased was a government employee)
time: 15–30 days (post field inspection by Revenue Inspector)

name: Birth Certificate Registration
documents: Hospital Discharge Summary / Form 1 (Institutional Delivery Slip)
Parents' Aadhaar Cards
Parents' Marriage Certificate or Address Proof
Affidavit from Notary / Magistrate (if applying after 1 year of birth)
School Admission Record (for delayed registration)
fee: Free within 21 days / ₹20–₹50 late registration fee

name: Death Certificate Registration
documents: Hospital Death Summary / Medical Certification of Cause of Death
Cremation / Burial Ground Receipt
Aadhaar Card of the Deceased (for cancellation & record)
Aadhaar Card of Applicant / Nearest Relative
Address Proof of Deceased
fee: Free within 21 days / ₹20–₹50 late registration fee

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (Registration & e-KYC)
documents: Aadhaar Card (linked with mobile number for OTP)
Land Ownership Documents (Khatauni / Land Record / Patta copy)
Aadhaar-seeded Active Bank Account Passbook
Ration Card Number / Family Register Details
time: 15–30 days (subject to state land record verification)

name: E-Shram Card (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
documents: Aadhaar Card
Aadhaar-linked Mobile Number
Bank Account Number with IFSC Code
Occupation / Skill Details (Construction, Agriculture, Domestic, Gig Worker)
Age Proof verifying 16–59 years

name: Marriage Registration Certificate
documents: Marriage Invitation Card or Religious Ceremony Certificate
Wedding Photographs (ceremony photo showing bride and groom)
Bride & Groom Age Proofs (Birth Certificate / Matriculation / Passport)
Bride & Groom Address Proofs (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
Identity Proof & Photos of 2 or 3 Witnesses present at marriage
Joint Affidavits in prescribed format
fee: ₹100 – ₹500 (varies by Special / Hindu Marriage Act & state)

name: Passport (Fresh / Renewal — Seva Kendra)
documents: Aadhaar Card (with correct Date of Birth and Address)
PAN Card or Voter ID
Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / Matriculation Certificate)
Address Proof (Bank Passbook / Electricity Bill / Telephone Bill)
Existing Old Passport (if applying for renewal / re-issue)
Non-ECR Proof (10th Standard or Higher Educational Qualification Certificate)

name: Driving Licence (Learner's & Permanent)
documents: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID for Identity & Address Proof
Age Proof (Birth Certificate / SSC Certificate / Passport)
Valid Learner's Licence Number
Medical Certificate (Form 1A signed by Registered Medical Practitioner)
Passport-size Photographs (3 copies)
Driving School Certificate (Form 5, if required for commercial vehicles)
time: 7–15 days (after clearing driving test at RTO)

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (Free LPG Gas Connection)
documents: BPL Ration Card showing woman applicant's name
Aadhaar Card of Woman Head of Household (Age 18+)
Aadhaar Cards of all adult family members listed in ration card
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked for subsidy DBT)
Proof of Address (Aadhaar / Electricity Bill)
14-Point Declaration / Self-Affidavit on LPG distributor form
fee: Free (Security deposit & first cylinder covered by Govt)
